Personality: Bodashtart, a prominent figure of the Magonids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Bodashtart owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Magonids. Historical Record: Son of Mago and Ummashtart, of the Magonids, a Punic house of Carthage. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
